title: Anchovy and broccoli spaghetti
summary: Anchovy and broccoli spaghetti is a italian dinner built around wholewheat spaghetti and anchovy fillets, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Start the sauce for Anchovy and broccoli spaghetti: soften the onion, then add garlic and anchovy fillets. Season wholewheat spaghetti and have the pasta water on to boil.
steps.tip: Salt the pasta water. It is the only chance to season the noodles themselves.

steps.instruction: Cook wholewheat spaghetti in the sauce while the pasta boils until tender with a bite. Save a cup of the cooking water before you drain.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce, loosening it with a splash of pasta water so it clings to broccoli.
steps.tip: Taste Anchovy and broccoli spaghetti before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Serve Anchovy and broccoli spaghetti straight away in warm bowls.  Serve with the spaghetti, simmered in salted water until tender.
